BAHA SA TAFT AT UN

Motorists and pedestrians wade through knee-deep floods at the corner of Taft and UN Avenues in Manila on Friday, August 22, following a heavy downpour caused by the inclement weather.

As of 11 a.m., PAGASA reported that the low-pressure area east of Aurora has intensified into Tropical Depression #IsangPH and made landfall over Casiguran, Aurora.

📸 The STAR/Edd Gumban

data.text:
[6:33AM] #Ikorodu
#Ogolonto
#TrafficUpdate

Smooth traffic flow from Aruna inwards Agric.
 It's getting slow approaching Aunty Kenny majorly due to commercial/bus stop activities, our traffic managers are on ground ensuring the needful is done. 
Moving inwards Idiroko, Ogolonto, Majidun, Orita Aje, all through to Itowolo moves rapidly.
 The return journey from Itowolo on the stretch back to Aruna is absolutely free.

Ita elewa axis is calm, likewise the Ebute axis for motorists coming through Ojogbe,  Igbogbo and Ibeshe.

 Connecting Oba Sekunmade is in good order but approaching Ogolonto intersection is slightly delayed due to traffic light alternation.
